Urvashi.note: The apsara beloved of Pururavas and mother of Ayus. Bound to him only by the condition that he never see her unclothed and her two pet rams go unharmed; lost him for it when the Gandharvas, to end their affair, stole the rams by night and he leapt up by lightning to save them, breaking the condition; relented afterward to grant him one night a year, which is where their sons were born. In an older frame she is also cursed to live a mortal's life on earth for a time, of which Pururavas is that sentence.

Menaka.note: An apsara sent to break Vishvamitra's penance; mother of Shakuntala, who was then raised by the sage Kanva.

Muni.note: Daughter of Daksha, wife of Kashyap; mother of the apsaras.

Rambha.note: Foremost of the apsaras, daughter of Muni.
